modos.descricao: Arma improvisada: +0 Rage, pode jogar 2 combat actions por 1 rodada

params.descricao: Improvised Weapon: permite 2 combat actions por 1 rodada

_metadata.texto_original: Weapon. A character need not equip with Improvised Weapon during the Equip/Ally Phase; play it instead during any combat. For 1 round, the character may play 2 damage-dealing Combat Actions. Discard Improvised Weapon after it is used in a combat.
_metadata.notas: A habilidade '2 damage-dealing Combat Actions' requer modificacoes no motor de combate para permitir acoes extras por rodada. Implementacao futura.
